alt: A focaccia filled with mortadella, soft cheese and basil, with fries and two dips on paper over slate.
The terrace at night: cream scalloped umbrellas lit red from below, empty tables and stools, string lights in the olive trees.
A pale cocktail in a coupe with a dried citrus wheel, on a dark table on the terrace; bar stools along the canal rail behind.
The terrace at dusk: olive trees lit from below, round tables, hanging baskets, a mural on the wall behind and narrowboats on the canal beyond.
A salt-rimmed margarita with a wedge of lime on a slate table out on the terrace, in the sun.
A blue Spinello spritz with mint and a slice of orange on the terrace rail, narrowboats moored along the canal behind.
The terrace fence from outside by day, under olive trees and hanging baskets of flowers.
A Scirocco, bourbon over one big ice cube with a twist of orange peel, on a pine table inside; the Gwenda letters on the wall behind.
A record on the turntable at the decks, lit warm from above.
The terrace at dusk: candlelit tables under cream parasols by the canal.
A salt-rimmed margarita and a red cocktail over ice on the bar, bottles glowing behind.
A bowl of golden crocchette with two dips.
The canal towpath beside the terrace, at sunset.
A Chez Pickle burger: sesame bun, melted cheese and shredded lettuce.
The gate with the Gwenda sign, lit red at night.
Pizza bread with salami and basil, fries and a herby dip.
A double cheeseburger steaming on the board, fresh off the grill.
Stools and benches on the terrace under festoon lights.
A smashed patty with melted cheese lifted off the griddle on a spatula.
